name: Pattern evolves inside bounded environment
description: Environment A displays an internally evolving pattern rather than behaving as an indivisible cube object.
steps: Read the Environment A diffusion node and its pattern field output
Press Step +1 and inspect the tick counter and Mean energy in A
Press Reset and verify the tick counter returns to zero
expected: A pattern-generating node is labelled pattern_A: field[10³]. Tick advances then resets to 0000.

name: Pattern A alters existing B algorithm spatially
description: The outgoing voxel field of A enters the activation rule of the already-running B algorithm.
steps: Keep Enable A → B connection on and coupling strength at 0.65
Press Step +1 about 12 times and inspect Spatial pattern divergence
Disable the connection, press Reset, step another 12 times and inspect Spatial pattern divergence
expected: Spatial pattern divergence is positive when connected; it returns to 0.0000 after reset and remains zero with the link disabled.

name: Continuous playback and environment visibility
description: The user can view either environment and observe its evolving pattern on a narrow display.
steps: Tap Run and observe tick advancing
Tap Pause and observe tick stop
Tap A only, B only and Both cubes
expected: The visible selected environment changes and simulation controls remain operable.

name: Pattern connection is exported with dimensional schema
description: Export records show the spatial pattern field and its mapping into the receiving algorithm.
steps: Inspect the JSON download and the browser export confirmation
expected: JSON contains two module states with 1,000 values each, A.pattern_A → B.excitation_B, type voxelwise_pattern_modulation, spatial mapping identity_xyz, and counterfactual data.
